name: rpc_cc_validate_matrix
identity_args: p_plan_id uuid, p_buyer_scope text, p_partner_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cc_validate_matrix(p_plan_id uuid, p_buyer_scope text, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_missing jsonb; v_drafts int; v_quote int;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tipo',tipo,'id',id,'nome',nome)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_missing
  FROM (
    SELECT 'produto' tipo, p.id, p.nome FROM public.produtos p
     WHERE COALESCE(p.ativo,true)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
            WHERE i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.product_id=p.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'microrganismo', m.id, m.nome FROM public.microrganismos m
     WHERE COALESCE(m.ativo,true)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
            WHERE i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.microrganismo_id=m.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
  ) s;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='draft'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE pricing_mode='quote_only')
    INTO v_drafts, v_quote
  FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices
   WHERE plan_id=p_plan_id AND buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
     AND partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
     AND customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', jsonb_array_length(v_missing)=0,
    'missing_items', v_missing, 'draft_count', COALESCE(v_drafts,0), 'quote_only_count', COALESCE(v_quote,0));
END $function$

name: gerar_codigo_lote
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gerar_codigo_lote(_ano integer DEFAULT (EXTRACT(year FROM now()))::integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_prefix text := 'LT-' || _ano::text || '-';
  v_next int;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX((split_part(codigo_lote, '-', 3))::int), 0) + 1
    INTO v_next
    FROM public.lotes
    WHERE codigo_lote LIKE v_prefix || '%';
  RETURN v_prefix || lpad(v_next::text, 4, '0');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_alerts(p_reference_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(alert_type text, severity text, title text, description text, amount numeric, count integer, action_key text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  -- 1 entregas sem faturamento
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'DELIVERIES_PENDING_BILLING'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Entregas confirmadas sem faturamento'::text,
         'Existem entregas concluídas que ainda não geraram conta a receber.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'entregas-nao-faturadas'::text
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 2 recebimentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Recebimentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a receber em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'receber-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
   WHERE ari.due_date < p_reference_date AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 3 pagamentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_PAYABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Pagamentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a pagar em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'pagar-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
   WHERE api.due_date < p_reference_date AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 4 NF-e pendente
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'PENDING_FISCAL_INVOICE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'NF-e pendente'::text,
         'Contas a receber aguardando emissão de NF-e.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'nfe-pendente'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 5 categorias sem DRE
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'UNCLASSIFIED_DRE'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Categorias sem classificação DRE'::text,
         'Algumas categorias usadas em títulos não têm grupo DRE definido.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'categorias-dre'::text
    FROM financial_categories fc
   WHERE fc.dre_group IS NULL
     AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.category_id = fc.id)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable ap WHERE ap.category_id = fc.id))
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 6 recorrências com falha
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_FAILED'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências com falha'::text,
         'Erros recentes na geração automática de títulos recorrentes.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (p_reference_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 7 recorrências atrasadas
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_DUE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências atrasadas para geração'::text,
         'Modelos recorrentes ativos com geração pendente.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true AND auto_generate = true
     AND next_generation_date IS NOT NULL AND next_generation_date < p_reference_date
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 8 contas sem centro de custo
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'MISSING_COST_CENTER'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Contas sem centro de custo'::text,
         'Títulos financeiros sem centro de custo associado.'::text,
         0::numeric,
         ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'))::int,
         'centros-custo'::text
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_entrega_build_snapshot_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'template_versao', 'termo-entrega-v1',
    'gerado_em', now(),
    'entrega', to_jsonb(e),
    'cliente', (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id),
    'ordem_servico', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id),
    'ordem_servico_onfarm', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id),
    'pedido_b2b', (SELECT to_jsonb(po) FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id),
    'comprovante', (SELECT to_jsonb(cp) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes cp WHERE cp.id = e.comprovante_id),
    'entregador', jsonb_build_object(
      'motorista', e.motorista, 'documento', e.motorista_documento,
      'telefone', e.motorista_telefone, 'veiculo', e.veiculo,
      'placa', e.veiculo_placa, 'tipo', e.veiculo_tipo),
    'destino', jsonb_build_object(
      'destinatario', e.destinatario_nome, 'telefone', e.destinatario_telefone,
      'logradouro', e.endereco_logradouro, 'numero', e.endereco_numero,
      'complemento', e.endereco_complemento, 'bairro', e.endereco_bairro,
      'cidade', e.endereco_cidade, 'uf', e.endereco_uf, 'cep', e.endereco_cep,
      'referencia', e.endereco_referencia, 'origem', e.endereco_origem),
    'recebedor', jsonb_build_object(
      'nome', e.recebedor_nome, 'documento', e.recebedor_documento,
      'cargo', e.recebedor_cargo, 'telefone', e.recebedor_telefone),
    'itens', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'etiqueta', to_jsonb(pe),
        'embalagem', (SELECT to_jsonb(eb) FROM public.estoque_embalagens eb WHERE eb.id = pe.embalagem_id),
        'lote', (SELECT to_jsonb(l) FROM public.lotes l WHERE l.id = pe.lote_id),
        'produto', (SELECT to_jsonb(pr) FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = pe.produto_id),
        'conferencia', (SELECT to_jsonb(ci) FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
                        WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.etiqueta_id = pe.id)
      )) ORDER BY pe.id)
      FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
      JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
      WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'checklist', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ck) ORDER BY ck.id)
                           FROM public.entrega_checklist ck WHERE ck.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ocorrencias', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(oc) ORDER BY oc.id)
                             FROM public.entrega_ocorrencias oc WHERE oc.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'divergencias', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('etiqueta_id', ci.etiqueta_id, 'status', ci.status,
                                          'quantidade', ci.quantidade, 'motivo', ci.motivo) ORDER BY ci.id)
      FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
      WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.status <> 'aceito'), '[]'::jsonb)
  ))
  INTO v
  FROM public.entregas e
  WHERE e.id = p_entrega_id;

  IF v IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entrega_nao_encontrada' USING ERRCODE = 'raise_exception';
  END IF;
  RETURN v;
END $function$

identity_args: p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric, p_exclude_order_id uuid
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric(6,2);
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  --     (evita dupla contagem com (a)); cancelados/reprovados ficam de fora.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_visit_responsible(p_user_id uuid, p_registro_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.registros_consultor r
     WHERE r.id = p_registro_id
       AND (
         r.consultor_responsavel = p_user_id
         OR r.created_by = p_user_id
         OR r.consultor_profile_id IN (
              SELECT pr.id FROM public.profiles pr WHERE pr.user_id = p_user_id
            )
       )
  )
$function$

name: has_active_user_cliente_access
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_user_cliente_access(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid, _levels text[] DEFAULT ARRAY['read'::text, 'execute'::text, 'manage'::text])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL OR _cliente_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  IF public.has_role(_user_id, 'administrador'::public.app_role) THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.user_clientes uc
     WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
       AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
       AND uc.is_active = true
       AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
       AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
       AND uc.access_level::text = ANY(_levels)
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dashboard_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r jsonb;
  v_rec_expected numeric := 0; v_rec_received numeric := 0;
  v_rec_open numeric := 0; v_rec_overdue numeric := 0; v_rec_partial numeric := 0;
  v_rec_overdue_count int := 0; v_rec_avg_days int := 0;
  v_pay_expected numeric := 0; v_pay_paid numeric := 0;
  v_pay_open numeric := 0; v_pay_overdue numeric := 0; v_pay_partial numeric := 0;
  v_pay_overdue_count int := 0;
  v_nfe_count int := 0; v_nfe_amount numeric := 0;
  v_deliv_count int := 0; v_deliv_amount numeric := 0;
  v_rec_recurring numeric := 0; v_pay_recurring numeric := 0;
  v_rec_errors int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  -- A receber (previsto: pelo vencimento no período)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE)::int,
         COALESCE(AVG(CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE),0)::int
    INTO v_rec_expected, v_rec_open, v_rec_overdue, v_rec_partial, v_rec_overdue_count, v_rec_avg_days
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A receber (realizado: por payment_date)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0)
    INTO v_rec_received
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (previsto)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < CURRENT_DATE),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < CURRENT_DATE)::int
    INTO v_pay_expected, v_pay_open, v_pay_overdue, v_pay_partial, v_pay_overdue_count
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (realizado)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0)
    INTO v_pay_paid
    FROM payable_payments pp
    JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- NF-e pendente
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)
    INTO v_nfe_count, v_nfe_amount
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true
     AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING';

  -- Entregas pendentes faturamento
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)
    INTO v_deliv_count, v_deliv_amount
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL;

  -- Recorrências ativas
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='RECEIVABLE'),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='PAYABLE'),0)
    INTO v_rec_recurring, v_pay_recurring
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true;

  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_rec_errors
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days');

  r := jsonb_build_object(
    'total_receivable_expected', v_rec_expected,
    'total_receivable_received', v_rec_received,
    'total_receivable_open', v_rec_open,
    'total_receivable_overdue', v_rec_overdue,
    'total_receivable_partial', v_rec_partial,
    'overdue_receivables_count', v_rec_overdue_count,
    'average_days_overdue', v_rec_avg_days,
    'total_payable_expected', v_pay_expected,
    'total_payable_paid', v_pay_paid,
    'total_payable_open', v_pay_open,
    'total_payable_overdue', v_pay_overdue,
    'total_payable_partial', v_pay_partial,
    'overdue_payables_count', v_pay_overdue_count,
    'projected_balance', v_rec_expected - v_pay_expected,
    'realized_balance', v_rec_received - v_pay_paid,
    'collection_rate', CASE WHEN v_rec_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_rec_received / v_rec_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'payment_rate', CASE WHEN v_pay_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_pay_paid / v_pay_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_count', v_nfe_count,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_amount', v_nfe_amount,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_count', v_deliv_count,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_amount', v_deliv_amount,
    'active_recurring_receivables_amount', v_rec_recurring,
    'active_recurring_payables_amount', v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_net_balance', v_rec_recurring - v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_generation_errors_count', v_rec_errors
  );
  RETURN r;
END $function$

name: validate_registro_status_transition
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_registro_status_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_allowed BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_user_role public.app_role;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
    -- Obter a role do usuário atual
    SELECT role INTO v_user_role FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;

    -- Matriz de transições permitidas
    v_allowed := CASE
      -- Fluxo padrão
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'rascunho' AND NEW.status::text IN ('finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'finalizado' AND NEW.status::text IN ('enviado_aprovacao', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- Durante Aprovação
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'enviado_aprovacao' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado', 'reprovado', 'rascunho', 'finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- Pós Aprovação
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'aprovado' AND NEW.status::text IN ('convertido_os', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- REABERTURA: Só administrador pode reabrir um aprovado para enviado_aprovacao
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'aprovado' AND NEW.status::text = 'enviado_aprovacao' AND v_user_role = 'administrador' THEN TRUE
      
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'convertido_os' AND NEW.status::text = 'arquivado' THEN TRUE
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'reprovado' AND NEW.status::text = 'arquivado' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END;

    IF NOT v_allowed THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transição inválida: não é possível mudar de "%" para "%". Conclua a etapa atual antes de avançar ou verifique suas permissões.',
        OLD.status, NEW.status
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;

    -- Validações adicionais ao finalizar (VT)
    IF NEW.status::text = 'finalizado' AND OLD.status::text = 'rascunho' THEN
      IF COALESCE(TRIM(NEW.problema_principal), '') = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Para finalizar a visita, informe o problema principal.'
          USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Log da transição com metadados estendidos
    INSERT INTO public.registros_consultor_status_log (
      registro_consultor_id, 
      status_anterior, 
      status_novo, 
      changed_by
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.id, 
      OLD.status::TEXT, 
      NEW.status::TEXT, 
      auth.uid()
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_notify_lab_on_programacao()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_produto_nome text;
  v_cliente_nome text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status::text <> 'aguardando' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(p.nome, m.nome, 'Bioinsumo')
    INTO v_produto_nome
    FROM (SELECT 1) x
    LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = NEW.produto_id
    LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = NEW.microrganismo_id;

  IF NEW.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT c.nome INTO v_cliente_nome
      FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm o
      JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = o.cliente_id
      WHERE o.id = NEW.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
  ELSIF NEW.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT c.nome INTO v_cliente_nome
      FROM public.ordens_servico o
      JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = o.cliente_id
      WHERE o.id = NEW.ordem_servico_id;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.notificacoes_operacionais (usuario_id, tipo, titulo, mensagem, link)
  SELECT ur.user_id,
         'nova_demanda_producao',
         'Nova demanda de produção',
         COALESCE(v_produto_nome, 'Bioinsumo')
           || COALESCE(' · ' || v_cliente_nome, '')
           || COALESCE(' · ' || ROUND(NEW.volume_necessario / 1000.0, 1)::text || ' L', ''),
         '/pcp?coluna=aguardando'
    FROM public.user_roles ur
   WHERE ur.role IN ('producao', 'administrador', 'gestor');

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

name: rpc_b2b_integrity_check
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_integrity_check()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador') AND NOT has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado';
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'pedido_sem_parceiro',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_orders po
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa WHERE pa.id = po.partner_id)),
    'planejamento_sem_pedido',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.production_planning pp
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id = pp.partner_order_id)),
    'os_sem_planejamento',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.ordens_servico os
       WHERE os.origem = 'b2b' AND os.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link pol WHERE pol.ordem_servico_id = os.id)),
    'timeline_orfa',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.production_timeline_events ev
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id = ev.partner_order_id)),
    'os_orfa_b2b',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.ordens_servico os
       WHERE os.origem = 'b2b' AND (os.partner_order_id IS NULL OR os.partner_order_item_id IS NULL)),
    'itens_sem_produto',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.partner_order_items poi
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = poi.product_id)),
    'links_invalidos',
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.production_order_link pol
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico os WHERE os.id = pol.ordem_servico_id))
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;
$function$

name: fn_fin_dashboard_kpis
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_dashboard_kpis(_from date, _to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'receitas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'receitas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_received) FROM receivable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'despesas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'despesas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paid) FROM payable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'inadimplencia_total', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE),0),
    'pagar_vencidas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE),0),
    'entregas_nao_faturadas_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entregas WHERE financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND receivable_id IS NULL),0),
    'entregas_nao_faturadas_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * p.valor_litro_brl) FROM entregas e
        LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id WHERE e.financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL),0),
    'nfe_pendente_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0),
    'nfe_pendente_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END $function$

name: fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH d AS (
    SELECT * FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
     WHERE microorganism_id = p_microorganism_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY (status='VALIDATED') DESC, version DESC
     LIMIT 1)
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d) THEN NULL ELSE (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'dossier_id', d.id,
      'version', d.version,
      'status', d.status,
      'blocked_reason', d.blocked_reason,
      'regulatory_category', d.regulatory_category,
      'strain', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_code,'')),''), nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_name,'')),'')),
      'formulation', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.formulation,'')),''),
      'label_guarantee', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.label_guarantee,'')),''),
      'mapa_status', d.mapa_status,
      'mapa_registration_number', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_registration_number,'')),''),
      'mapa_holder', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_holder,'')),''),
      'mapa_valid_until', d.mapa_valid_until,
      'mapa_not_applicable_reason', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_not_applicable_reason,'')),''),
      'published_ncm', d.published_ncm,
      'published_cest', d.published_cest,
      'effective_from', d.effective_from,
      'effective_to', d.effective_to,
      'review_technical', d.technical_review_status,
      'review_regulatory', d.regulatory_review_status,
      'review_fiscal', d.fiscal_review_status,
      'has_label_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type='ROTULO'),
      'has_report_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type IN ('LAUDO','CERTIFICADO_ANALISE')),
      'expired_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                             WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL
                               AND x.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND x.valid_until < current_date),
      'ncm_approved', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c
                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.status='APPROVED'),
      'ncm_candidates', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
      'checklist_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
      'checklist_pending', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.item_key ORDER BY c.item_key)
                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='PENDING'),'[]'::jsonb),
      'checklist_not_applicable', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                                      'item_key',c.item_key,'justification',c.justification) ORDER BY c.item_key)
                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='NOT_APPLICABLE'),'[]'::jsonb),
      'checklist_confirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='CONFIRMED'),
      'presentations_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id),
      'presentations_units_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
                                           WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.units_confirmed),
      'presentations_gtin_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
                                          WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.gtin_confirmed))
    FROM d) END;
$function$

name: send_partner_simulation_to_manager_secure
get_portal_cliente_b2b_order_detail_secure
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_order_detail_secure(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = p_order_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found'; END IF;

  IF v_order.cliente_id IS NULL
     OR NOT public._portal_cliente_user_has_link(auth.uid(), v_order.cliente_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'header', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_order.id,
      'numero', v_order.numero,
      'status', v_order.status,
      'created_at', v_order.created_at,
      'requested_delivery_date', v_order.requested_delivery_date,
      'estimated_delivery_date', v_order.estimated_delivery_date,
      'approved_at', v_order.approved_at,
      'partner_id', v_order.partner_id,
      'partner_nome', COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
      'total', v_order.total,
      'origin_simulation_id', v_order.origin_simulation_id,
      'cultura', v_order.cultura,
      'area_total_ha', v_order.area_total_ha
    ),
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', it.id,
        'nome', COALESCE(it.produto_nome_snapshot, p.nome, m.nome),
        'codigo', COALESCE(it.produto_codigo_snapshot, p.codigo, m.codigo),
        'item_tipo', CASE WHEN it.microrganismo_id IS NOT NULL AND it.product_id IS NULL THEN 'microrganismo' ELSE 'produto' END,
        'quantidade', it.quantidade,
        'unidade_medida', it.unidade_medida,
        'volume_ml', it.volume_ml,
        'preco_unitario', it.preco_unitario,
        'subtotal', it.subtotal,
        'produtos', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', p.nome,
          'codigo', p.codigo,
          'funcao_completa', p.funcao_completa,
          'modo_acao', p.modo_acao,
          'modo_aplicacao', p.modo_aplicacao,
          'formulacoes', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'microrganismos', jsonb_build_object(
                'nome', mf.nome,
                'concentracao_label', mf.concentracao_label
              )
            ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
            FROM public.formulacoes f
            LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos mf ON mf.id = f.microrganismo_id
            WHERE f.produto_id = p.id AND mf.id IS NOT NULL
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) END,
        'microrganismos', CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', m.nome,
          'codigo', m.codigo,
          'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
          'funcao_agronomica', m.funcao_agronomica
        ) END
      ) ORDER BY it.created_at)
      FROM public.partner_order_items it
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = it.product_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = it.microrganismo_id
      WHERE it.order_id = v_order.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO v_result
  FROM public.partner_accounts pa
  WHERE pa.id = v_order.partner_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_simulation_detail_secure(p_simulation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sim public.partner_simulations%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_sim FROM public.partner_simulations WHERE id = p_simulation_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found'; END IF;

  IF v_sim.cliente_id IS NULL
     OR NOT public._portal_cliente_user_has_link(auth.uid(), v_sim.cliente_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_cliente_vinculo';
  END IF;

  IF v_sim.status::text NOT IN ('enviada_gestor', 'convertida_pedido') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'simulation_not_visible';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'header', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_sim.id,
      'titulo', v_sim.titulo,
      'status', v_sim.status,
      'total_cheio', v_sim.total_cheio,
      'created_at', v_sim.created_at,
      'updated_at', v_sim.updated_at,
      'converted_order_id', v_sim.converted_order_id,
      'partner_id', v_sim.partner_id,
      'partner_nome', COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
      'cultura', v_sim.cultura,
      'area_total_ha', v_sim.area_total_ha,
      'objetivo_tecnico', v_sim.objetivo_tecnico
    ),
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', si.id,
        'nome', COALESCE(si.produto_nome_snapshot, si.nome, p.nome, m.nome),
        'codigo', COALESCE(si.produto_codigo_snapshot, p.codigo, m.codigo),
        'item_tipo', si.item_tipo,
        'quantidade', si.quantidade,
        'unidade_medida', si.unidade_medida,
        'volume_ml', si.volume_ml,
        'valor_unitario_cheio', si.valor_unitario_cheio,
        'subtotal', si.subtotal,
        'produtos', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', p.nome,
          'codigo', p.codigo,
          'funcao_completa', p.funcao_completa,
          'modo_acao', p.modo_acao,
          'modo_aplicacao', p.modo_aplicacao,
          'formulacoes', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'microrganismos', jsonb_build_object(
                'nome', mf.nome,
                'concentracao_label', mf.concentracao_label
              )
            ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
            FROM public.formulacoes f
            LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos mf ON mf.id = f.microrganismo_id
            WHERE f.produto_id = p.id AND mf.id IS NOT NULL
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) END,
        'microrganismos', CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'nome', m.nome,
          'codigo', m.codigo,
          'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
          'funcao_agronomica', m.funcao_agronomica
        ) END
      ) ORDER BY si.created_at)
      FROM public.partner_simulation_items si
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON p.id = si.product_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = si.microrganismo_id
      WHERE si.simulation_id = v_sim.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO v_result
  FROM public.partner_accounts pa
  WHERE pa.id = v_sim.partner_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_visit_immutability()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_is_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  -- Only enforce on visitas
  IF COALESCE(OLD.natureza_registro, 'ocorrencia'::natureza_registro_consultor)
     <> 'visita'::natureza_registro_consultor THEN
    -- still bump version for consistency
    NEW.version := COALESCE(OLD.version, 1) + 1;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_is_admin := public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::app_role);

  -- If previous status was 'finalizado', lock most fields
  IF OLD.status = 'finalizado'::status_registro_consultor THEN
    -- Allowed transitions from finalizado:
    --  - finalizado -> convertido_os  (OS generation)
    --  - admin can perform any change
    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
      IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status
         AND NEW.status <> 'convertido_os'::status_registro_consultor THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Visita finalizada é imutável (registro %). Transição de status não permitida: % -> %',
          OLD.id, OLD.status, NEW.status
          USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
      END IF;

      -- Block edits to core visit fields
      IF NEW.cliente_id       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cliente_id
      OR NEW.fazenda_id       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.fazenda_id
      OR NEW.talhao_id        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.talhao_id
      OR NEW.cultura_id       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cultura_id
      OR NEW.data_visita      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.data_visita
      OR NEW.hora_inicio      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.hora_inicio
      OR NEW.hora_fim         IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.hora_fim
      OR NEW.observacoes      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.observacoes
      OR NEW.consultor_responsavel IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.consultor_responsavel
      OR NEW.natureza_registro     IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.natureza_registro
      OR NEW.finalized_at     IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.finalized_at
      OR NEW.finalized_by     IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.finalized_by THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Visita finalizada é imutável (registro %). Campos protegidos não podem ser alterados.',
          OLD.id USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Auto-increment version
  NEW.version := COALESCE(OLD.version, 1) + 1;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

name: b2b_actor_scope
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_ok boolean, org_partner uuid, user_partner uuid, user_partner_count integer, partner_valid boolean, has_catalog boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH pr AS (
    SELECT o.partner_account_id
      FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
     WHERE p.user_id = _uid AND p.ativo = true AND o.ativo = true AND o.status = 'ativa'
     LIMIT 1
  ), pu AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int c, min(partner_id::text)::uuid pid FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id = _uid
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr),
         (SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr),
         (SELECT pid FROM pu), (SELECT c FROM pu),
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pr.partner_account_id
                  WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL),
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
$function$
